name: Metharbital
summary: Metharbital was patented in 1905 by Emil Fischer working for Merck. It was marketed as Gemonil by Abbott Laboratories. It is a barbiturate anticonvulsant, used in the treatment of epilepsy. It has similar properties to phenobarbital.

pharmacology.text: It has similar properties to phenobarbital.

uses.text: It was marketed as Gemonil by Abbott Laboratories. It is a barbiturate anticonvulsant, used in the treatment of epilepsy.

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, dizziness and poor coordination. Like other barbiturates, it can lead to dependence, stopping suddenly after regular use can cause dangerous withdrawal with seizures, and overdose can stop breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起嗜睡、頭暈與協調變差。和其他巴比妥類一樣，它可能導致依賴，經常使用後突然停用可能出現伴隨癲癇的危險戒斷，過量則可能使呼吸停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起嗜睡、头晕与协调制差。和其他巴比妥类一样，它可能导致依赖，经常使用后突然停用可能出现伴随癫痫的危险戒断，过量则可能使呼吸停止。

fact.en: Metharbital was patented in 1905 by Emil Fischer, the Nobel prize winning chemist who, with Joseph von Mering, had introduced the first barbiturate, barbital, in 1903.
fact.zh: Metharbital 在1905年由諾貝爾獎得主、化學家埃米爾．費雪取得專利。費雪曾與約瑟夫．馮．梅林在1903年推出第一個巴比妥類藥物巴比妥。
fact.zhHans: Metharbital 在1905年由诺贝尔奖得主、化学家埃米尔．费雪取得专利。费雪曾与约瑟夫．冯．梅林在1903年推出第一个巴比妥类药物巴比妥。
